BrandTemplate.description: An object representing a brand template with associated metadata.

title.description: The brand template title, as shown in the Canva UI.

view_url.description: A URL Canva users can visit to view the brand template.

create_url.description: A URL Canva users can visit to create a new design from the template.

created_at.description:
When the brand template was created, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

updated_at.description:
When the brand template was last updated, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

Thumbnail.description: A thumbnail image representing the object.

width.description: The width of the thumbnail image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the thumbnail image in pixels.

url.description:
A URL for retrieving the thumbnail image.
This URL expires after 15 minutes. This URL includes a query string
that's required for retrieving the thumbnail.
